name: Kit

intro.text: {player}! Edinburgh Castle! I've been up and down the Royal Mile three times. My legs have filed a complaint.
Seven Stones each... wait, you've got more than me. Typical. One more go, for old times' sake?

win: Every time. Every single time. I'm putting it on a tea towel.
after: There's a ceilidh tonight. I'm told I dance like a shopping trolley with a wonky wheel.
